COHORT_SW1.scope: Independent cohort methodology exploration; source-defined point classification, not the v1 sensor configuration or event endpoint.
limitations: Processed source CSVs lack timestamp and day identifiers; no verified chronological order, event matching, alarm/day or true time coverage claims.
Labels follow source <4 mmol/L plus duration rules and backfilled reference, unlike PhysioCGM native <70mg/dL.
Precomputed wearable feature causality is based on source code review, not full raw-data reconstruction.
No clinical or prospective efficacy conclusion; input sensors differ from PhysioCGM.
Patient-specific calibration not used; training/validation row partition is descriptive within other subjects and test subject is entirely unseen.
